messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Decision: the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time [decision; valid 2025-04-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-01]
- The catalog depends on image-resizer [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-28]
- Decision: search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes [decision; valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-07]
- Boreal noticed that the catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change [observation; valid 2025-08-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-12-2]
- Decision: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months [decision; valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-20]
- Cinder noticed that the catalog's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change [observation; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15-2]
- Search-indexer depends on the catalog [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-03]
- Boreal owns the catalog [valid 2025-10-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-20-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the catalog [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-10-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023 [decision; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Boreal noticed that the catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout [observation; valid 2025-04-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-10]
- The catalog deploys only on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
    earlier: The catalog deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-05-02 to 2025-11-12; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
- Decision: reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs [decision; valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- Boreal noticed that reporting's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change [observation; valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-06]
- INC-2025-023: search-indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-24; the root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004 [decision; valid 2025-03-06 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- Cinder noticed that search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change [observation; valid 2025-08-29 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29-2]
- The handover note of 2025-11-18 wrongly recorded Ember as the owner of search-indexer [valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction]
- Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017 [decision; valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
